theme: An open Saturday, Croatia three days out.
greeting: Nothing on the calendar today, Dan, with the girls in residence and the St. Pete stay holding through the weekend. The quiet is the opening to close the last Croatia pieces before Tuesday's flight.

needsAttention.title: Halloween: St. Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 5 deadline is today. The Oct 18-Nov 1 Airbnb and car both cover Halloween, so a Maine call changes three bookings at once, and the Portland house picks up a real deadline. Deciding from Croatia means deciding badly.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags are on the ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued Basic Economy fare shows zero checked bags; two 55L duffels won't fly as carry-on. Verify on Eurowings Discover's own site and buy bags now before European counter rates. Overdue since Aug 25.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 19 Cavtat night + transfer
needsAttention.detail: The charter ends noon Sept 19 at ACI Komolac; you need a refundable Cavtat room and a pre-booked marina transfer locked before Tuesday, since the boat has no connectivity. Overdue since Aug 26.

needsAttention.title: Book the St. Pete landing-gap nights
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sept 20 but the girls aren't picked up until Sept 22, leaving the nights of the 20th and 21st still without a room near St. Pete. Overdue since Aug 25.

needsAttention.title: Reach the Nautilus instructor
needsAttention.detail: Confirm the Sept 12 boarding time and arrange the Sept 19 return transfer; the packet asks for this before the course week, and bandwidth drops once underway.

flagged.title: SVP, Government Affairs at True Anomaly
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn alert surfaced the True Anomaly SVP, Government Affairs posting from Sept 4, close to your governance and public-affairs lane.

flagged.title: Amex balance rose this cycle
flagged.detail: myFICO flagged an increase on the Amex account and Experian's monthly statement also landed; both are informational, no action forced.

flagged.title: care.com password reset
flagged.detail: A reset email arrived from care.com alongside a new caregiver application, worth a glance if you didn't request it.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, travel promos, and receipts.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Kabocha squash, yukon gold potatoes & cipolline
recipe.why: Early autumn is peak winter squash and cipolline onion season, so this roasting-pan supper leans right into what's coming into the markets.

tasks.title: Book the refundable backup car, Sept 20-Oct 5
Buy EU plug adapters + a US power strip

acts.line: The calendar is empty and the St. Pete stay runs quiet with the four girls in residence.
An open stretch, rare this month, with Croatia's unbooked pieces sitting as the day's gravity.
Tomorrow's 9 AM Sunday review with Mike is the one fixed point ahead; the shared board gets cleared then.
